title: Automatic mode
preparationTitle: Prepare a dossier or admin area

portfolio.promisesTitle: Benefits promised in the accepted offer
portfolio.promiseDeadline: Promised deadline: {{days}} days from the contractual starting date
portfolio.noFixedDeadline: The offer sets no fixed deadline.
portfolio.noFixedDuration: The offer sets no fixed exposure duration.
portfolio.personalNoBenefits: This personal contribution promises no sponsorship benefit.
portfolio.promisesUnknown: Promised benefits cannot be established from a qualified offer.

reasons.delivery_late: Delivered after the promised deadline: review any required follow-up.
reasons.payment_confirmation_unknown: The payment confirmation date is missing or invalid. Check the payment evidence before settling its responsibilities.
reasons.contribution_type_unknown: The contribution type is unrecognised. The commitments applicable to this dossier must be established.
reasons.payment_unconfirmed: The payment is not confirmed. The browser cannot establish that benefits are owed or delivered.
reasons.payment_refunded: A refund is recorded. Check its impact on benefits, the invoice and credit note; refunding does not automatically settle commitments.
reasons.payment_disputed: The payment is disputed. A human decision and confirmed facts are needed before continuing.
reasons.commitment_needs_confirmation: The benefits accepted at purchase are not established. Qualify the offer with evidence; today's pricing cannot replace the historical agreement.
reasons.offer_payment_mismatch: The recorded offer does not match the payment amount, currency or fingerprint. Check the original agreement.
reasons.offer_invalid: The recorded offer cannot establish the promised benefits. The dossier needs clarification.
reasons.obligation_offer_mismatch: A commitment does not match the accepted offer. Check its benefit, destination and quantity before settling it.
reasons.obligation_amendment_unverified: A commitment change or dispensation lacks the required audit. A documented decision is needed.
reasons.obligation_timing_unknown: The benefit's deadline or duration is not sufficiently established. Check the accepted terms.
reasons.fulfilment_evidence_mismatch: The delivery evidence does not match this exact commitment and version. Qualified evidence is required.
reasons.fulfilment_snapshot_unqualified: The existing delivery does not retain all sources and versions needed to prove the promised benefit.
reasons.duration_attestation_missing: The promised duration lacks the required attestation. Visibility at one moment does not prove the whole period.
reasons.promised_obligation_missing: A benefit in the accepted offer is missing from the tracked commitments. Restore its tracking before declaring the dossier balanced.
reasons.orphan_fulfilment_evidence: Evidence is not linked to a recognised commitment. Check its association without inventing delivery.
reasons.deadline_origin_unknown: The deadline's starting date is not established. Check the agreement before calculating the next step.
reasons.duration_in_progress: The benefit must remain available for a period that is still in progress. This responsibility remains pending.
reasons.duration_restart_required: A visibility interruption requires checking the promised period and how it resumes.
reasons.personal_payment_has_sponsorship_records: A personal contribution contains unexpected sponsorship records. Clarify the dossier to avoid assigning benefits that were never promised.

portfolio.reconcileHelp: I will only check the durable result of the uncertain action. No dossier, sending, publication or refund will be replayed. Resuming the passage remains a separate decision.
portfolio.title: Balance responsibilities
portfolio.mission: I compare each confirmed payment with its promised benefits, prepare authorised work and keep a report for your review before moving to the next dossier.
portfolio.scope: The passage covers confirmed payments recorded when it starts. Drafts stay private; publication, rejection, refunds and sending await your confirmation in their usual screens.
portfolio.nextWhy: I will reread the next payment, its commitments and server evidence. Only eligible private preparations can be made; preparing never fulfils a benefit.
portfolio.balanced: Responsibilities were balanced during this passage. Each dossier is dated in the report; new facts may reopen work.
portfolio.passComplete: Passage finished. Some responsibilities remain open or unknown; the report keeps them for your review.
portfolio.newPayments: {{count}} new payments are outside this passage. Start a new passage to include them.
portfolio.benefits: Promised benefits: {{expected}} · delivered with evidence: {{fulfilled}} · waived: {{waived}} · outstanding: {{outstanding}} · unknown: {{unknown}}
portfolio.draftPrepared: Private draft prepared for {{channel}} / {{target}}. Approval and delivery remain outstanding.
portfolio.draftPreserved: Existing draft preserved for {{channel}} / {{target}}. Its preparation does not establish publication.
portfolio.humanReview: Open the dossier to review and confirm
portfolio.reportHelp: These observations and actions come from the server. Delivered benefits remain separate from drafts and dispensations. The delivery balance does not replace reviewing promised deadlines and durations. Reading the report runs no action.
portfolio.reasonUnknown: This dossier needs the check identified by the server ({{code}}). Open it to review the facts and next action.
portfolio.resumeHelp: Pausing, editing, an open dialogue, navigation or a hidden tab stop the next step. An already submitted action may finish; review its result. Reloading displays the report without restarting. Resuming requires your action.

phases.review: Report available — the next step awaits your start
phases.explaining: Here is what I will check and why
phases.advancing: Checking one dossier and preparing authorised work
phases.paused: Paused — no next step will be started

statuses.balanced: Balanced at the time of this check
statuses.waiting: Waiting for a result or due date

errors.invalid_payment_facts: A confirmed payment has an amount or currency that needs checking. The passage did not start.
errors.unavailable: The report is unavailable. Read it again when the server responds; earlier results do not prove its current state.
errors.forbidden: Your access does not permit this read. No private dossier is retained on screen.
errors.stale: The passage changed in another session. Read its state before resuming.
errors.uncertain: The request did not return a certain result. I will not replay it. Read the report and reconcile any actions before resuming.

help: I open the relevant screens and prepare available actions. You keep control of decisions and confirmations.
startHelp: Choose the followed payment or an admin area, then start when you are ready.
humanPageStep: Complete the information, review the content or confirm in the usual panel. Check the result shown in this area, then choose another preparation if needed.
humanStep: Complete the information, review the content or confirm in the usual panel. I then read the payment facts again before continuing. You can also check them now.
choiceHelp: Choose the action to prepare when several decisions are possible. Its confirmation remains a separate step.
completeHelp: The server reports no remaining step for this payment. New information may reopen the journey.
resumeHelp: An interruption, entering information in the dossier or manual navigation pauses this mode. After reloading, start it voluntarily; this guide does not save decisions or entered information.
reasonUnavailable: Review the current dossier to find the next step. Information or evidence may still be needed.

phases.explaining: Here is the next step and its reason
phases.preparing: Showing the relevant area and preparing available actions
phases.awaiting_confirmation: Your turn: complete, review or confirm
phases.paused: Paused — resume at your own pace
phases.blocked: A check is needed before continuing
phases.error: I cannot check the next step right now

errors.unavailable: The read did not complete. Read again and resume when the dossier is available.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this read. Return to the dossier with the appropriate access.
errors.stale: The context changed or the action is no longer available. Read the dossier again before resuming.
